scope: Development diagnostic on the five previously exposed CCD entry reference cases; not independent confirmation or automatic submission policy
intervention: Only fixed yellow RGB(255,255,0) width=2 sheet-pixel rectangle inside independently reviewed upper target body. Draw after original sheet rendering, before identical MLX resizing. No text/prompt/number/frame/order/canvas changes. Never cover wheel/lane/contact contour.
review: A annotates 3 cases; B annotates 2; each original viewed individually, counterpart reference allowed, model outputs forbidden. Reciprocal rendered-sheet review before inference. Annotation not independent of historical human-readable target references.
frozen: existing weights and MLX sync/native/deepstack fix
existing original Q3 12 candidates and original sheet algorithm
Q1 Q2 Q4 cached outputs and original final contact side space
original frame PTS and preexisting AI entry references
execution: Fresh process per case/arm, one actual Q3 query; 5 baseline +5 marked =10 actual calls. No other new model calls. Original 4-call diagnostics replayed with original responses except Q3; three other final outputs copied and checked.
contract_failure: Any obscuring/wrong marker or pixel/hash/prompt/frame contract failure invalidates run, fixed before predictions. Historical baseline response mismatch investigated explicitly; no silent reuse as identical baseline.
scoring: Reuse frozen interval grade and paired difference with epsilon0.3; unknown unchanged. Valid offered integer required for semantic success; fallback/snapped values reported, not rule recognition.

success_gate.entry_MAE_nonincrease: For the shared unknown true time in each fixed interval, mean paired absolute-error-difference upper bound <= 1e-9 seconds

limits: baseline0/5 makes loss check weak; cannot certify regression robustness
marker supplies expert identity and attention jointly; cannot isolate pure identity effect
5case exposed development only; no official S2 or automatic deployment improvement
result_analysis: Compare raw response, parsed selection, error bounds and selected frame visual evidence; trace selection failure and distinguish direct observations from causal hypotheses. If gate fails stop fixed candidate; no second tuning sweep.
comparison: Fresh baseline of this experiment is primary paired control; historical response equality checked separately; mismatch forbids same-baseline success claim
small_marks: Use the same 2px rectangle at all eligible boxes. Small distant upper-body boxes may rasterize to filled tiny rectangles. Never enlarge beyond verified body just to increase salience; record rendered size and inspect actual bounded images.
visual_review: Review actual bounded model-input images, not only full-resolution sources. Save those explicitly.
